name: sparring
title_zh: 拿你自己的仓库当考卷，答不上就当场追问到底
tagline_zh: 面试前最怕的不是不会，是讲不清自己写的东西。它从你的仓库里抽概念卡、出题、追问，答得含糊就顺着代码往下逼。
tagline_en: It builds concept cards straight from your repo, then drills you: vague answers get chased down through the.
desc_en: Hard technical interviewer for codebases the user built. Use when the user asks to be drilled, quizzed, grilled, mock-interviewed, or tested on a project, wants a concept-card bank built from a repo, wants a lesson, wants to refine cards, wants to explain code and be corrected, or wants a design document grilled before implementation. Modes: build-bank, drill, lesson, refine, read, mock, grill-des
why_zh: 题目来自你真实的提交和文件，不是通用题库。答错不放过，会翻出对应代码让你解释为什么这么写。
why_en: Questions come from your real commits and files, not a generic bank. Wrong answers aren't dropped — it pulls up the code and.
limit_zh: 只对本地能读到的仓库有效，私有依赖或没 clone 下来的子模块它看不到；mock 模式只覆盖你指定的那几个文件。
limit_en: Only works on repos it can read locally; private deps or uncloned submodules are invisible. Mock mode covers only the files you name, not the whole.
title_en: Drills you on your own repo until you can defend it
